title: Unique Spicy Ethiopian Lamb Tagine
description: This cultured dish features tender lamb in a spicy Ethiopian tagine sauce, made with sesame seed oil and a mother-sauce base, and is gluten-free friendly.
instructions: Heat the sesame seed oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, dried apricots, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven, where it will cook at 300 degrees for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the pot from the oven and let cool slightly before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
